title: The AC Isn't Cooling
source: 原創基礎課程：小綠書 U05 情境功能改寫
summaryZh: 描述冷氣吹出暖風的現象，並和服務人員約定技師可到訪的時間。

learning.objectiveZh: 不自行判斷故障原因，清楚描述冷氣沒有降溫並約定一段可配合的到訪時段。

vocabulary.en: A machine that cools the air in a room.
To make a place or thing less warm.

vocabulary.example: The fan is blowing warm air.

vocabulary.en: A person trained to check or repair equipment.
vocabulary.example: A technician can check the unit.

vocabulary.en: An agreed time for someone to visit or meet.
Free or ready to be used at a particular time.

task.titleZh: 換個條件：洗衣機不能排水
task.setupZh: 你的洗衣機不能排水。只描述看到的現象，不猜零件故障；詢問最早可到訪時段，再提出你能在家的時間。

steps.partner: Hello. What seems to be the problem?
We can send a technician tomorrow afternoon.
steps.promptZh: 詢問有沒有更早的時段。
steps.frame: Do you have an earlier appointment?
steps.sample: Do you have a morning appointment instead?

steps.partner: We have a window from nine to eleven.
steps.promptZh: 說明你能在家的時段，並確認技師到訪前會聯絡。
steps.sample: That works. Will the technician call before arriving?

success: 我有描述設備和一個可觀察現象。
我有問清楚並確認到訪時間窗。
我沒有猜測故障原因或承諾修理費。

spokenPractice.noteZh: 先用核心句完成任務；以下是可選加強，不要求第一次全部記住。

alternatives.clear: My AC isn't cooling the room.
alternatives.guidanceZh: properly 可自然地表示「運作得不太正常」，先描述現象即可。
come by 是口語的「過來一趟」，先聽懂即可。

alternatives.natural: Do you have a morning appointment?
alternatives.guidanceZh: appointment 用來確認可預約的時段。

drill.setupZh: 聽到對方只能安排下午後，禮貌詢問早上是否有時段。

turns.speaker: 服務人員
turns.text: The first available time is tomorrow afternoon.

turns.speaker: 你
turns.text: Do you have a morning appointment instead?

drill.successZh: 提出另一個可行時段即可；不必重複整段報修內容。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hello. My air conditioner isn't cooling the room.
sentences.zh: 你好，我的冷氣沒有把房間吹涼。
sentences.note: isn't cooling 說明觀察到的狀況，不推測設備哪裡故障。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Is it making a strange noise?
sentences.zh: 很抱歉聽到這個情況。有發出奇怪的聲音嗎？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: No, but it is blowing warm air.
sentences.zh: 沒有，但它吹出來的是暖風。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: When did you first notice the problem?
sentences.zh: 你第一次注意到這個問題是什麼時候？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: We have a technician available tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我們明天有技師可以安排。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Do you have a morning appointment?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That works. Do I need to be at home?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes. The technician will call before arriving.
sentences.zh: 需要。技師到之前會先打電話。

questions.q: What is the air conditioner doing?
questions.explanationZh: A 說冷氣正在吹出暖風。

questions.q: When did the learner first notice the problem?
questions.explanationZh: 服務人員詢問第一次注意到問題的時間，A 回答昨天下午。

questions.q: What time is the appointment window?
questions.explanationZh: 服務人員先說明明天有技師，再確認上午九點到十一點的時段。
